title: Coach
disclaimer: Coach suggestions are worked out from your watch data and general training rules. This is not medical advice. If you feel pain, dizziness or anything else wrong, stop and see a doctor.

rules.title: How this suggestion is made
rules.body:
Coach adds up fatigue points from the signals it has: readiness (from your watch, or how you say you feel), HRV, the 7-day against 28-day training load, last night's sleep and sleep debt, yesterday's strain, the recovery time left on your watch, and days active in a row. A signal that is missing counts for nothing.

0 to 1 points: fresh, the plan goes ahead as written.
2 to 3: fair, the plan is cut to 85%.
4 to 5: tired, the session becomes an easy one or active rest.
6 or more: very tired, rest.

A hard session is never placed the day after a hard day. With no plan, Coach gives a general suggestion from the state of your body alone. There is no AI here, only the rules above.

runWalk.note: 8 weeks, 3 sessions a week: 1 minute of jogging and 2 minutes of walking at first, growing to one jog of 20 to 30 minutes. Your heart rate leads, not your pace: stay in zones 2 to 3 and walk when it reaches zone 4. A 1 km re-test in weeks 1, 5 and 8 shows your pace at the same heart rate. Walking is part of the plan, not a step back. If you have a health condition, or have been inactive for a long time, check with your doctor before you start.

steps.warmup: Warm-up {{minutes}} minutes: a brisk walk or slow jog.

steps.recovery: Run very easy in zone 1 to 2. Walking breaks are fine.
steps.long: Long run in zone 2. Slow is right.
steps.tempo: {{minutes}} minutes of tempo: breathing hard but steady, zones 3 to 4.
steps.intervals: Repeat {{reps}} times: {{work}} hard (zone 4), then {{rest}} easy jog.
steps.race: Run {{distance}}. Start easy and add in the second half if you feel good.
steps.jogWalk: Repeat {{reps}} times: jog {{run}}, then walk {{walk}}. Walk sooner if your heart rate reaches zone {{zone}}.
steps.continuous: Jog {{minutes}} minutes in a row, slowly. If your heart rate reaches zone {{zone}}, walk until it settles, then jog again.

hrGuide.title: Heart rate guide
hrGuide.keep: Keep the jog in zones {{low}} to {{high}}: {{from}} to {{to}} bpm.
hrGuide.walk: From zone {{zone}} ({{from}} bpm), walk until it settles back to zone 2 ({{back}} bpm or lower). If you cannot say a sentence, slow down whatever the watch says.
hrGuide.calm: Slow is the point, and walking when the cue comes is the plan working. If something hurts or you feel dizzy or unwell, stop and take it easy. This is general guidance, not medical advice.

guide.title: Session guide
guide.hint: Start a Run workout on your watch, then tap Start here. The phone buzzes at every change and, while your watch sends its heart rate, tells you when to walk. The watch records the workout.
